range.target: Forecast-year records in the first weekly January snapshot; later backfill excluded.
range.interpretation: The chart displays the central 50% model interval. Half of the predictive probability lies outside it. Methods and evidence include the wider nominal 90% interval. Both assume exchangeable normal log completion rates. Two rolling-origin tests are insufficient to measure interval coverage.
includes: historically observed late additions before the January snapshot
excludes: backfill after the first January snapshot
structural changes in collection or Arcola coverage
assumptions: Recent historical completion rates transfer from AIID to Arcola.
Log completion grows at a constant average daily rate within the remaining period.
The four historical years are exchangeable despite their declining completion ratios.
